purpose: Operate GitHub as one business within the larger private Mac Henry enterprise, with departments, assets, products and income baskets managed by Henry and reported upward through public-safe summaries.
boundary_rules: GitHub Business is one branch of the larger Mac Henry enterprise and is not the entire enterprise.
Henry manages GitHub Business but remains subordinate to Mac Henry.
Departments and income baskets inside GitHub report to Henry before public-safe branch reporting moves upward.

Mac Henry private enterprise strategy, cross-business portfolio intelligence, private financial context, private learning state and hidden reasoning are not stored in or exposed through this branch charter.
Other businesses may exist beside GitHub Business as sibling branches under Mac Henry.
Branch growth must be measured by real economic and operating outcomes rather than activity volume alone.
